question: When a creature with level up has level abilities that grant it other abilities, do those grants overwrite its level up ability?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the abilities a leveler grants itself do not overwrite its other abilities, including level up.
expected.answer: The abilities a leveler grants to itself don’t overwrite any other abilities it may have. In particular, they don’t overwrite the creature’s level up ability; it always has that.
